description: Preview the price of a Kubernetes cluster configuration without creating it. Takes the same arguments as create_kubernetes_cluster.

controlPackage.description: Package label for the control-plane nodes (from list_kubernetes_packages). Overrides package.

keypair.description: SSH key pair name to install on nodes for the login user cloud (from list_ssh_keys). Node SSH is on the cluster's public IP at port 2222 and up, one port per node.

networkId.description: UUID of an existing network to place the cluster in. Omit to auto-create one.

package.description: Package label for every node (from list_kubernetes_packages). Send it alone for one size, with controlPackage or workerPackage to change one node type, or leave it out when you send both.

workerPackage.description: Package label for the worker nodes (from list_kubernetes_packages). Overrides package.

name: get_cost_estimate_kubernetes
title: Get Kubernetes cost estimate
